$description: Object-icon silhouettes on a 32 grid. Geometry only — no colours and no gradients anywhere in this file. Lighting is the one shared recipe under `object` in tokens/tokens.json, so the whole set regrades from there. A part supplies a facet (which end of the ramp it faces), a signed tone (a lighting offset, not a colour) and a bevel; the renderer supplies everything else. Names that also exist in ../Icon/icons.json inherit that glyph as their small-size fallback; names that do not must declare one with `glyph`.
